steps.sub: proves the Lesson 10 dedupe actually produced one row per day

code:
-- A membership can never be ACTIVE and PAUSED on the same day.
-- Any row returned here is a real data problem, not a false alarm.

select a.member_id, a.membership_id, a.status, b.status
from periods a
join periods b
    on a.membership_id = b.membership_id
   and a.status <> b.status
   and a.status_start_date < b.status_end_date_inclusive
   and b.status_start_date < a.status_end_date_inclusive
caption: Zero rows returned means the rule held. Any row means it didn't.
